mapper.select: SELECT P.*, COALESCE(, P.patient_name) AS sample_name, M.project_name AS project_name FROM patients P LEFT JOIN meta2db_sample_metadata M ON M.patient_id = P.patient_id WHERE P.patient_id = #{patientId}
SELECT * FROM microbe_abundance WHERE patient_id = #{patientId} ORDER BY sample_date DESC

SELECT standard_abundance_id AS abundance_id, A.patient_id, A.sample_id, COALESCE(, A.sample_id) AS sample_name, A.sample_date, A.microbe_name_standard AS microbe_name, A.abundance_value, A.abundance_unit AS unit, A.normalization_method AS method FROM microbe_abundance_standard A LEFT JOIN meta2db_sample_metadata M ON M.patient_id = A.patient_id AND BINARY M.sample_id = BINARY A.sample_id WHERE A.patient_id = #{patientId} ORDER BY A.sample_date DESC, A.sample_id ASC, A.microbe_name_standard ASC

SELECT standard_abundance_id AS abundance_id, A.patient_id, A.sample_id, COALESCE(, A.sample_id) AS sample_name, A.sample_date, A.microbe_name_standard AS microbe_name, A.abundance_value, A.abundance_unit AS unit, A.normalization_method AS method FROM microbe_abundance_standard A LEFT JOIN meta2db_sample_metadata M ON M.patient_id = A.patient_id AND BINARY M.sample_id = BINARY A.sample_id WHERE A.patient_id = #{patientId} AND A.sample_id = #{sampleId} ORDER BY A.abundance_value DESC, A.microbe_name_standard ASC

SELECT standard_abundance_id AS abundance_id, A.patient_id, A.sample_id, COALESCE(, A.sample_id) AS sample_name, A.sample_date, A.microbe_name_standard AS microbe_name, A.abundance_value, A.abundance_unit AS unit, A.normalization_method AS method FROM microbe_abundance_standard A LEFT JOIN meta2db_sample_metadata M ON M.patient_id = A.patient_id AND BINARY M.sample_id = BINARY A.sample_id WHERE A.patient_id = #{patientId} AND A.sample_id = #{sampleId} ORDER BY A.abundance_value DESC, A.microbe_name_standard ASC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT A.patient_id, A.sample_id, COALESCE(, A.sample_id) AS sample_name, MAX(A.sample_date) AS sample_date, COUNT(*) AS feature_count, SUM(A.abundance_value) AS abundance_total FROM microbe_abundance_standard A LEFT JOIN meta2db_sample_metadata M ON M.patient_id = A.patient_id AND BINARY M.sample_id = BINARY A.sample_id WHERE A.patient_id = #{patientId} GROUP BY A.patient_id, A.sample_id, M.profile_sample ORDER BY sample_date DESC, A.sample_id ASC

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT P.patient_id) AS patient_count, COUNT(DISTINCT CONCAT(M.patient_id, ':', M.sample_id)) AS sample_count FROM patients P JOIN microbe_abundance_standard M ON P.patient_id = M.patient_id WHERE LOWER(TRIM(P.disease)) = 'healthy'
AND P.body_site = #{bodySite}
SELECT * FROM cytokine_abundance WHERE patient_id = #{patientId} ORDER BY sample_date DESC
SELECT P.patient_id FROM patients P LEFT JOIN meta2db_sample_metadata M ON M.patient_id = P.patient_id WHERE P.patient_name = #{patientName} OR M.profile_sample = #{patientName}
SELECT P.patient_id FROM patients P JOIN patient_diseases PD ON P.patient_id = PD.patient_id JOIN diseases D ON PD.disease_id = D.disease_id WHERE D.disease_name = #{diseaseName}

SELECT P.patient_id, P.patient_name, COALESCE(, P.patient_name) AS sample_name, M.project_name AS project_name, P.age, P.gender, P.country, P.disease, P.risk_score, P.risk_level FROM patients P LEFT JOIN meta2db_sample_metadata M ON M.patient_id = P.patient_id
AND P.patient_id = #{queryValue}
AND (P.patient_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{queryValue}, '%') OR M.profile_sample LIKE CONCAT('%', #{queryValue}, '%'))
AND P.disease LIKE CONCAT('%', #{queryValue}, '%')
ORDER BY patient_id ASC
